# Mufakir Ansari - AI Researcher & Data Scientist

> Data scientist and AI researcher building scientific AI systems across High-Performance Computing (HPC), quantum circuit knitting, self-supervised representation learning, genomics, and time-series forecasting. Graduate researcher at The University of Toledo with 10 accepted/submitted peer-reviewed papers and 47 verified peer reviews (43 Elsevier EAAI + IEEE).

## Key Information
- Name: Mufakir Ansari (Mufakir Qamar Ansari)

## Core Research Areas
- High-Performance Computing & Quantum Circuit Knitting: GPU-accelerated tensor network simulation, dynamic wire-cutting heuristics, and distributed quantum simulation via CUDA/C++ and Qiskit.
- Self-Supervised Learning & Representation: Computational pathology foundation models trained on 277,000+ WSIs using SimCLR and DINO with distributed PyTorch.
- Genomic Feature Selection & HDLSS: Author of DDFF (Distributional Discriminative Feature Filtering) operating in linear O(pn) time with rigorous Total Variation equivalence.
- Deep Time-Series & Physics-Informed ML: Multi-horizon spatio-temporal traffic and weather forecasting on edge sensors and OSC supercomputing clusters.

## Selected Publications
- Distributional Discriminative Feature Filtering: A Scalable Framework for High-Dimensional Low-Sample-Size Biomedical Data - 2026 25th IEEE International Conference on Machine Learning and Applications (ICMLA), DOI: 10.1109/ICMLA69890.2026.00030
- Scalable Quantum Circuit Knitting via Dynamic Wire-Cutting Heuristics - Submitted to ACM Transactions on Quantum Computing (TOGS)
- Self-Supervised Representation Learning for High-Resolution Histopathology Whole Slide Images - 2025 IEEE International Conference on Bioinformatics and Biomedicine (BIBM)
- Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Networks for Multi-Horizon Highway Traffic State Forecasting - IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems (T-ITS)
